title: @mickeyjotheatre live in nyc when?!?!? thank you @Phoenix Arts Club f...
transcript: Join me to watch Mickey Joe live in London, but here on my couch in New York. Just a casual meeting of the Mickey Joe Theater in New York City. I wish more than anything that I could be in London today to see Mickey Joe's show live. He's one of my favorite theater people, one of my favorite creators, one of my favorite humans, and I'm thrilled Phoenix Art Club had a. It's an Aaron James cameo, everyone! We did great! Mickey Joe's show was so much fun. A mix of performances and interviews with incredible West End talent. Possibly my favorite moment of the night was when Mickey Joe and Jacob Fowler sang the Aliza's cause that is one of my favorite songs of all time. And then I was surprised because my friend Katie Oxman was there. Katie is a New York City based actor but is currently in London. She's in a show called fun at the Beach, Romp Bompalop. You should go see it if you're there. And I love getting to hear her sing feed the Birds. Grace Moatt sang from sick. She was so fun! I can't wait to see her in Mean Girls. My dog is being very silly at this point, but I think he was enjoying the show. I'm just so proud of Mickey Joe for putting this all together. I can't imagine doing a live show, it seems very. But it was incredible and I hope he brings it to.
